EndToEndRealTimeDialog.title: Real-time speech dialogue
EndToEndRealTimeDialog.requestParamsDescription:
# Client request messages

## Common fields

| Field     | Description                         |
| --------- | ----------------------------------- |
| type      | The message type.                   |
| seq       | The message serial number.          |
| timestamp | The UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. |

## StartTranscription (Start real-time transcription)

### Starts a real-time transcription and creates a real-time session.

```json
type:StartTranscription
seq:1
timestamp:1719242591197

{
    "playCode": "c00aa8467a",   // The scenario code.
    "metaData": {},   // Metadata. You can add key-value pairs here for placeholders in the opening remarks. For example, if you set the placeholder ${name} in the opening remarks in scenario management, you can pass {"name": "John Doe"} here.
    "selfDirected": true   // Specifies whether to enable autonomous Q&A. If intent recognition returns "other", the model's autonomous answering capability is used.
}
```

## ProcessTranscription (Send audio data)

### Uploads a segment of audio data.

```json
type:ProcessTranscription
seq:1
timestamp:1719242591197
ack:required

{
	"dataSourceType": "customer",   // The data source type.
	"data": [0,0,0,0,0]   // The binary audio stream.
}
```

- \`dataSourceType\` identifies the data source, such as "customer" or "service".

  - \`customer\`: Indicates audio data from the customer.

  - \`service\`: Indicates audio data from third-party prompts, such as those from a carrier.

  - You must differentiate between the sources. You can send only the customer's audio data because this API does not currently process audio data from the \`service\` source.

## StopTranscription (Stop transcription)

### Actively ends the real-time session.

```json
type:StopTranscription
seq:1
timestamp:1719242591197

{}
```

The payload is empty.
EndToEndRealTimeDialog.responseParamsDescription:
# Server-side response (push) messages

## TranscriptionStarted (Session/transcription started)

```json
type:TranscriptionStarted
seq:1
timestamp:1752922002409

{
    "sessionId": "1752922001S001nojxboa26z",  // The unique identifier for the business session.
    "openingRemarks": "Hello, are you Mr. Li?"  // The opening remarks text.
}
```

- \`sessionId\`: The unique identifier for the business session.

- \`openingRemarks\`: The content of the opening remarks.

## TranscriptionResultChanged (Transcription text changed \[Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) result])

```json
type:TranscriptionResultChanged 
seq:29 
timestamp:1754659632826 

{
  "content": "Yes, you",
  "messageId":"5da6a7211fd54f7087f74f2f028308e7"
}
```

- \`content\`: The current transcribed text.

- \`messageId\`: The unique identifier for the message.

## SentenceEnd (Sentence transcription complete \[streaming audio data of agent reply])

```json
type:SentenceEnd 
seq: 3 
timestamp: 1754659629166

{
  "data": [73,68,51,4,0,0,0],    // The binary audio data.
  "messageId": "",    // The unique message identifier.
  "messageEnd": true   // The flag indicating the end of the current message round.
}
```

## BizProcessing (Business intent recognition result)

```json
type:BizProcessing 
seq: 3 
timestamp: 1754659629166

{
  "id": "175465963554371b6ffdea5eb446188fc366df451b23b",
  "choices": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "finishReason": "stop",
      "delta": {
        "intentionCode": "1940679612569849856",
        "intentionScript": "Hello, this is xxx. We see that you have a pre-approved credit line of x0,000, so we are reminding you to check it out on our WeChat mini program or app.",
        "intentionName": "Customer asks about the caller's identity",
        "callTime": "819",
        "hangUpDialog": false,
        "interrupt": false
      }
    }
  ],
  "created": "1754659635543",
  "success": true
}
```

- This message primarily contains content related to intent recognition. For more information about the output fields, see [RealTimeDialog](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/api-dianjin-2024-06-28-realtimedialog?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i2#:~:text=%E5%AE%9E%E6%97%B6%E4%BC%9A%E8%AF%9D-,RealTimeDialog%20%2D%20%E5%AE%9E%E6%97%B6%E4%BC%9A%E8%AF%9D,-%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E6%97%B6%E9%97%B4%EF%BC%9A).

## SentenceInterrupted (Sentence interrupted \[audio cache needs to be cleared])

```json
type:SentenceInterrupted 
seq: 32 
timestamp: 1754659635543 

{}
```

- The body of this message is empty. When you receive this message, you must clear the audio cache and stop playing the previous audio content to create an interruption.

## TranscriptionEnd (Transcription ended \[session end suggested: agent determines the session can end])

```json
type:TranscriptionEnd 
seq: 367 
timestamp: 1754659669964 

{}
```

## TranscriptionCompleted (Transcription fully complete, WebSocket connection can be closed)

```json
type:TranscriptionCompleted
seq:3
timestamp:1752922030325

{}
```

## Status codes and error handling

If an error occurs when connecting or sending a message, the server-side returns a standard Error message:

```json
type:Error
seq:3
timestamp:1752922030325

{
  "code": "401",
  "message": "Token is invalid or has expired"
}
```

Common error codes:

| Code | Description                |
| ---- | -------------------------- |
| 400  | Invalid request parameter. |
| 401  | Authentication failed.     |
| 500  | Internal service error.    |

sessionIds.description: Session ID list. When useUrl is true, the response includes OSS URLs. You can specify up to 1000 sessions. If you specify more than 1000, only the first 1000 are processed. When useUrl is false, the response includes full analysis results. You can specify up to 10 sessions. If you specify more than 10, only the first 10 are processed. This parameter is optional. If sessionIds is empty, the API retrieves results for sessions created between startTime and endTime. If sessionIds is not empty, the API retrieves results for the specified sessions. You cannot leave both sessionIds and the time range empty.

useUrl.description: Whether to return an OSS URL instead of full analysis results. If true, the response includes an OSS URL that expires in one hour. Default is true. Supports up to 1000 sessions. If you specify more than 1000, only the first 1000 are processed. If false, the response includes full analysis results. Supports up to 10 sessions. If you specify more than 10, only the first 10 are processed.

startTime.description: Start time in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. If sessionIds is not empty, you can query the session analysis results using the specified session IDs.

endTime.description: The end time, which must be in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. If sessionIds are provided, the system queries session analysis results based on these IDs.

asc.description: Whether to sort in ascending order. Default is true, which sorts by session creation time in ascending order. If false, sorts in descending order.

status.description:
Task execution status for session analysis.

- init means the task has not started

- pending means the task is queued

- running means the task is in progress

- error means the task failed

- success means the task completed successfully

ossUrl.description: OSS URL for the session analysis result. The URL expires in one hour.

List of document statuses to filter documents.

### Document parsing status codes

*Status codes: WaitRefresh, InQueue, FetchingData, Embedding, Completed, FormatError, Error*

- Completed: Active. Document parsing completed.

- Error: Inactive. Document parsing failed.

- FormatError: File format error. Re-upload the file in the correct format if it is encrypted or incomplete.

- InQueue: Pending. Document is waiting for parsing.

- Parsed: Parsing completed.

- Other statuses are internal system states. For example, WaitRefresh means the task is scheduled. FetchingData means parsing is in progress. Embedding means index building is in progress.

RunChatResultGeneration.summary: Generates chat responses. You can select a model for the conversation and choose streaming or non-streaming output.

messages.description: Messages to input into the model.

content.example: 你是一个信息处理专家

modelId.description: The model service type. Get this value from the /api/app/config API endpoint in the llmHelperTypeList field.

sessionId.description: Session ID. Use this to mark a conversation.

stream.description: Streaming mode. Set to true for streaming responses. Set to false for full responses. Default is false.

tools.description: Tool information. Specify a list of tools the model can call. When multiple tools are provided, the model selects one to generate a response.

function.description: An object containing name, description, and parameters.

description.description: A string describing the tool function. This helps the model decide when and how to call it.

name.description: A string representing the tool function name. It must contain only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens. Maximum length is 64 characters.

parameters.description: An object describing the tool parameters. It must be a valid JSON Schema.

type.description: A string indicating the tool type. Currently, only "function" is supported.

index.description: Sequence number of the generated result. Default is 0.

imageCount.description: Number of images. Returned by models such as wanx.

imageTokens.description: Image tokens. Returned by models such as qwen-vl.
